run_main: run the main function to generate audio-driven photoreal video samples from a trained diffusion model checkpoint
run_generate_sequences: run the generate sequences function to produce motion samples using DDIM sampling with classifier-free guidance
run_render_pred: run the render prediction function to create MP4 videos from generated body and face motion data blocks
run_setup_model: run the setup model function to load a FiLMTransformer checkpoint and optionally wrap it in a classifier-free sampler
run_setup_dataset: run the setup dataset function to load local audio-visual data and create a test DataLoader with chunking
